race.comment: Tricky contest. BONOYSTER (6) win record hardly excites but ticks a few boxes from the good gate. Sat on the strong tempo from the wide gate with a game second over 1000m at Muswellbrook. Lone victory came at this course and looks hard to beat. MR CORNSTAR (5) was a month between runs when he covered plenty of ground early, only to fade in the straight and finish ninth in a C1 at Muswellbrook over 1000m. Fitter now from a better gate. Each way. BIG LON (8) comes here off a 54-day let-up after finishing a plugging third in C1 grade over 1100m at Wyong. Sticky gate and stays in the mix. MR TRACKSIDE (4) gelding resuming. Primed with the two trials and should appreciate the solid tempo. Respect.
